info.name: Mux Animated Images Signing Keys API

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items to include in the response

params.name: page
params.description: Offset by this many pages, of the size of `limit`

items.docs: Returns a list of signing keys.

Creates a new signing key pair. When creating a new signing key, the API will generate a 2048-bit RSA key-pair and return the private key and a generated key-id; the public key will be stored at Mux to validate signed tokens.

params.name: SIGNING_KEY_ID
params.description: The ID of the signing key.

items.docs:
Retrieves the details of a signing key that has previously
been created. Supply the unique signing key ID that was returned from your
previous request, and Mux will return the corresponding signing key information.
**The private key is not returned in this response.**

params.name: SIGNING_KEY_ID
params.description: The ID of the signing key.

items.docs: Deletes an existing signing key. Use with caution, as this will invalidate any existing signatures and no JWTs can be signed using the key again.
